derivations.rate-boundary: Declared uniform 1 hour over three calendar days. Jan31 contributes (1/3)*90 = 30; Feb1-Feb2 contribute (2/3)*120 = 80; exact total 110.
derivations.subcent: Declared 1 unit over two days with separate daily quotations at .01: .005 + .005 exact = .01; per-segment half-even rounds .00 + .00 = .00.
derivations.weighted_activity: One dated segment, 2.50 weighted activity units * 17.00/unit = 42.50; no resource-use inference.
derivations.leap_year: 2024-02-28 to 2024-03-02 has 3 days including Feb29; a Mar1 boundary apportions 2/3 and 1/3.
derivations.incomplete_capacity: Source pool 110; independent available capacity 10 instrument-hours. Known use 3 hours gives 33; unknown second use remains unknown and 77 is unallocated.
